item.title: Enable WizTelemetry Global Monitoring
item.description: To use the full functionality of WizTelemetry Global Monitoring, you need to install the WizTelemetry Platform Service, WizTelemetry Monitoring, WizTelemetry Alerting, and WizTelemetry Global Monitoring extensions, and perform the following configurations. Prerequisites You need to have the platform-admin role in the KubeSphere platform. For more information, refer to Users and Platform Roles. The WizTelemetry Platform Service, WizTelemetry Monitoring, WizTelemetry Alerting, and WizTelemetry Global Monitoring extensions have been installed.
